data.name: Schema
FindVersionHash
data.value: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT source_content_hash FROM company_payment_source_versions WHERE source_id=@source AND version_id=@version),'')

data.name: FindRowHash
data.value: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT row_hash FROM company_payment_rows WHERE source_id=@source AND source_version_id=@version AND source_row_id=@row),'')

data.name: ReadRow
data.value: SELECT sequence AS "Sequence",known_ticks AS "KnownTicks",payload::text AS "Payload" FROM company_payment_rows WHERE source_id=@source AND source_version_id=@version AND source_row_id=@row

data.name: LastKnownTicks
data.value: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT known_ticks FROM company_payment_rows ORDER BY known_ticks DESC LIMIT 1),0)

data.name: InsertRow
data.value: INSERT INTO company_payment_rows(source_id,source_version_id,source_row_id,import_id,payer_company_id,beneficiary_company_id,pay_amt,pay_cnt,known_ticks,row_hash,payload) VALUES(@source,@version,@row,@import,@payer,@beneficiary,@amount,@count,@ticks,@hash,CAST(@payload AS JSONB)) RETURNING sequence AS "Sequence",known_ticks AS "KnownTicks",payload::text AS "Payload"

data.name: Activity
data.value: SELECT v.source_content_hash AS "SourceContentHash",v.known_ticks AS "SourceKnownTicks", MAX(r.known_ticks) AS "ObservedKnownTicks",COUNT(*)::text AS "ObservedRowCount",MAX(r.sequence)::text AS "Watermark", COALESCE(SUM(CAST(r.pay_amt AS NUMERIC)) FILTER(WHERE r.beneficiary_company_id=@company AND r.payer_company_id<>@company),0)::text AS "IncomingAmount", COALESCE(SUM(CAST(r.pay_cnt AS NUMERIC)) FILTER(WHERE r.beneficiary_company_id=@company AND r.payer_company_id<>@company),0)::text AS "IncomingCount", COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE r.beneficiary_company_id=@company AND r.payer_company_id<>@company)::text AS "IncomingRows", COALESCE(SUM(CAST(r.pay_amt AS NUMERIC)) FILTER(WHERE r.payer_company_id=@company AND r.beneficiary_company_id<>@company),0)::text AS "OutgoingAmount", COALESCE(SUM(CAST(r.pay_cnt AS NUMERIC)) FILTER(WHERE r.payer_company_id=@company AND r.beneficiary_company_id<>@company),0)::text AS "OutgoingCount", COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE r.payer_company_id=@company AND r.beneficiary_company_id<>@company)::text AS "OutgoingRows", COALESCE(SUM(CAST(r.pay_amt AS NUMERIC)) FILTER(WHERE r.payer_company_id=@company AND r.beneficiary_company_id=@company),0)::text AS "SelfAmount", COALESCE(SUM(CAST(r.pay_cnt AS NUMERIC)) FILTER(WHERE r.payer_company_id=@company AND r.beneficiary_company_id=@company),0)::text AS "SelfCount", COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE r.payer_company_id=@company AND r.beneficiary_company_id=@company)::text AS "SelfRows" FROM company_payment_rows r JOIN company_payment_source_versions v ON v.source_id=r.source_id AND v.version_id=r.source_version_id WHERE r.source_id=@source AND r.source_version_id=@version AND r.known_ticks<=@ticks AND v.known_ticks<=@ticks AND (r.payer_company_id=@company OR r.beneficiary_company_id=@company) GROUP BY v.source_content_hash,v.known_ticks
